description: Works without a Gameye account or token. Compare the installed Gameye agent skills with the latest pack on GitHub, and update them. Finds installs made with the skills CLI (user-wide or in this project) and the Claude Code plugin gameye@gameye. Without apply it only checks and changes nothing. With apply=true it runs each outdated install's own updater (npx skills update for the Gameye skills only, or claude plugin update) when the operator set GAMEYE_ENABLE_SKILLS_UPDATE=1; otherwise it lists the commands for the user to run. Ask the user before applying. Also reports the skills pack bundled with this server (1.7.1). Updates come only through those package managers. This server ships a pinned copy of the skills reviewed at build time; the skill and template tools never fetch skill text at runtime, and only gameye_update_skills reaches GitHub, when called.

apply.description: Run the updates for outdated installs. Omit or false to only check.

installedVersion.description: The `Pack version:` from the gameye skill you have loaded, used when no install is found on disk

name: gameye_update_skills
title: Check and update the Gameye skills
